Noah (Sales): Quick ask — Prospect Delta wants a hosted API key for a 10-day POC. They want auto-rotation every 72h and the ability to revoke immediately after demo. Can we support that out of the box?

Priya (SE): Yes. From Console -> Teams -> API Keys create a Temporary key and set TTL=10d. Rotation every 72h can be achieved by scheduling the admin rotate endpoint. We usually ship a tiny cron script. Also scope the key to only generation and embeddings.

Arun (Security): Need to ensure: (1) KMS audit logging enabled for the org for the entire POC; (2) IP allowlist added if they require network restrictions; (3) document who has ability to call revoke in the SQ.

Priya (SE): Example rotate job:
```
#!/bin/bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/rotate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"key_name":"delta-poc-1851234567"}'
```
(Or use the builtin scheduled rotations in the Console for org admins.)

Sam (Infra): Note: if Delta switches to Dedicated or Private later, keys must be created against that deployment; hosted keys won't work. Confirm deployment mode before creating.

Noah (Sales): Delta confirmed hosted. They also asked if rotation events can be posted to their Slack channel.

Priya (SE): We can register a webhook on key lifecycle events (created/rotated/revoked). Org admin needs to add the callback URL under org settings -> webhooks. We can include a signed header X-RW-Signature for verification.

Arun (Security): For revocation: call POST /v1/admin/keys/{key_id}/revoke. Also list steps for apps that cache tokens — suggest forcing a client restart or clearing SDK cache. Capture key_id and operator in audit logs.

lifecycle-bot: Event: key.created name=delta-poc-1851234567 id=key_Zx9b ttl=10d scopes=[generation,embeddings] creator=Priya

Priya (SE): I'll post a short runbook with: create steps, sample rotate cron, revoke steps, webhook example, and sample SQ entries (who, why, retention).

Sam (Infra): I can add a terraform snippet for org admins to accept webhook and enable rotation scheduling.

Arun (Security): I'll review the SQ wording and sign off once runbook is up.

Noah (Sales): Thanks all — once runbook is live I'll share with Delta and schedule the demo. :thumbsup:

Priya (SE): On it — ping if they need a mid-POC manual rotate.
